idiom: hit the nail on the head
meaning: to describe exactly what is causing a problem, or to be exactly right
literal_translation: точно визначити суть справи; сказати саме те, що потрібно
example: You hit the nail on the head when you said the team needs more time.
origin: From carpentry: a hammer blow that strikes the head of the nail drives it in cleanly and exactly.

wrong_meanings.meaning: to damage something with a hammer
wrong_meanings.why_wrong: This is the literal physical meaning, not the idiomatic one.

wrong_meanings.meaning: to make a mistake on purpose
wrong_meanings.why_wrong: The idiom means being exactly right, not deliberately wrong.
This is the opposite; the idiom means identifying the main point clearly.

explanation: 'Hit the nail on the head' means to identify exactly the cause of a problem or to say exactly the right thing. It is common in discussions when someone summarizes a situation accurately.
